warnings.detail: DP account 67786137 is attributed to Bharat Jaisinghani Family Trust 3, not to the "AJAY T JAISINGHANI" the holder line prints: the family's own investment register (`NEW INVESTMENT SHEET.xlsx`, sheet `TRUST INVESTMENT`, row 2) records 347 Swapeco Pre-Series-A CCPS of ₹100 face under this trust — the exact instrument and quantity this statement prints, whose 347 × ₹100 is the ₹34,700 total it prints. The holder line names the TRUSTEES; no Swapeco holding appears under them anywhere in the register.

this statement carries no text layer — its glyphs are vector outlines — so the words were recovered by rendering the page at 600 dpi and reading it (lib/ocr.mjs). The 1 row(s) read reproduce the statement's own printed Total Valuation of 34700.00 to the paisa, which is the check that licenses publishing them. Ask HDFC for a re-export with fonts embedded to remove the need for it.

1 holding(s) carry units and NO market value: the implied price is exactly a face-value denomination with no paise, on a name that declares none. A depository records the value a security was allotted at where it has no price for it, and multiplying by that produces a valuation nobody struck. Rows: SWAPECO SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED (347 at 100.0000).
